name: Made-in-China.com
description: Comprehensive directory for industrial machinery, hardware, electronics, and audited Chinese manufacturers.
fullDescription: Made-in-China.com is an authoritative B2B platform focused on Chinese industrial equipment, hardware components, building materials, and heavy manufacturing. With rigorous third-party supplier audits by Bureau Veritas and SGS, it is highly trusted by institutional and large-scale commercial buyers.
features: Comprehensive audit reports verified by Bureau Veritas and SGS
Strong focus on industrial hardware, machinery, consumer electronics, and tools
Virtual 3D factory tours showing real operating lines and assembly robotics
Secured trading services with escrow payment protection
Multilingual customer support in English, Spanish, Portuguese, and French
